info.name: Aatlas API — Auth, tenant, policy and guardrails
info.description:
Signup, sign-in, tenant/settings, roles and pricing guardrails for the Aatlas platform. Local defaults target http://localhost:8080.

The happy-path requests store tokens, ids and a spent refresh token into collection variables, so later requests can use {{accessToken}} etc. without copying anything by hand. Run the folder top to bottom the first time — several requests depend on ones above them having run first.

Each email is randomised at send time, because the address is globally unique — a fixed one would 409 on the second run.
